Shipped Local AI

Comparison format pilot: local coding agents

The comparison pilot ships one verdict-first guide covering three coding agents, outbound links to both evergreen guides and the latest digest, a distribution pack, and this log entry in the same pull request.

m
Machine Made WorldsSep 16, 2026 · 3 min read

In this article

MotivationWhat changedHow it was doneAgent trailVerification evidence
Follow the journal ↗

The journal pilots a verdict-first comparison format with one article covering three local-friendly coding agents. The live article is the local coding agents comparison.

Motivation

Readers asked which coding agent fits a modest local rig: an open-source editor agent, a self-hosted platform agent, or an editor-embedded hosted agent. A single verdict-first page with a criteria grid, best-for notes, method notes, and reader questions answers that faster than three separate essays, and it reuses the existing article template with no new components.

What changed

One new comparison post with a verdict-first lead, a seven-row criteria grid, three best-for sections, a scope-honest method box, a five-question reader section, and a distribution pack, linking out to both evergreen guides and the latest digest. Published guide bodies stay untouched under the standing preservation gate; the rebuilt related grid links the new article from same-topic pages automatically. This log entry ships in the same pull request per the standing same-request rule.

How it was done

The work stayed on the comparison branch cut from the main line: preflight on the private remote and login first, then the new post sources plus the distribution pack, then this log entry through the entry generator with full provenance metadata. A planned hand-edit of both evergreen guides was reverted when the preservation gate flagged published bodies as immutable; cross-linking now runs one way from the new article plus the automatic related grid. The deterministic site build, the full unit suite, and the presence gate all passed before the pull request opened against the main line.

Agent trail

The build owner drafted the article and the link-backs, generated this entry, and ran every gate locally. Reviewers check the exact pushed head in parallel, and the merge carries the article, the guide edits, and this entry together.

Verification evidence

The deterministic site build passed with the new article included, the full unit suite passed, and the presence gate reported covered by this entry. Every product claim in the article links a primary source address, and the article reports workflow observations only with no synthetic scores. Full review text is recorded in the linked review thread.
